theGap: The live site has 81 miss-you pages and they are overwhelmingly "miss you MESSAGE for <person>" plus regional-language quotes. There is NO English "miss you quotes for <person>" page at all. The prior miss-you-100 run measured that message/quotes return materially different SERPs and that the site over-built "message" - this wave takes the quotes half.
